mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and subsequently higher costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 500,000 units per month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 500,000 does not lead to a statistically significant positive return in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS MoM < 0 for 2 months
failure_condition: If the combined condition of UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS MoM < 0 for 2 months does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ > 3% does not lead to a statistically significant positive return in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined condition of FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -5% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days in more than 60% of the cases.
